title: Business data (NFC Hubs Phase 1)
description: Contract for src/businesses/<slug>/business.json. The literal string '[PLACEHOLDER - replace]' marks an unconfirmed value and triggers the pending state (FR-024). A missing key or empty string is a data error, not a placeholder.

wifiSsid.description: Displayed as inert text only. Never a connection mechanism (FR-007, Principle IV).

placeId.description: Google place ID for the writereview link (FR-006).

contact.description: Source of the entry types that derive from contact values: the vCard (FR-020) and the tel: link. A business declares it only if it uses one of those types.

entries.description: Array order IS the customer-facing priority order. Which types a business uses, and in what order, is chosen per instance and is not fixed by the spec (FR-016, FR-018).

id.description: Stable key. Becomes the Phase 2 /r/<slug> route segment; renaming breaks analytics continuity.

url.description: Required when type=link; forbidden otherwise. review and maps derive their destination from placeId, tel from contact.phone - so there is one place to change each format.

allOf.$comment: An entry that derives its destination from contact values cannot resolve without them. Catching it here fails the BUILD; resolve.js would otherwise degrade it to a pending entry, which hides a data error behind a legitimate-looking state.
